_note: Org-owned MCP server declaration channel (spec 0091). Setup reads ONLY the '.mcpServers' object below — declare your org's servers there (NOT under '_example', which is inert documentation). Each entry maps a server name to how it is reached: 'transport' is 'stdio' (default), 'http', or 'sse'. stdio entries carry 'command'/'args'/'env'; remote (http/sse) entries carry 'url'/'headers'. This file is org-owned and excluded from upstream sync; it ships empty and carries no operational server or credential. See docs/org-mcp-declaration.md. Note: remote (http/sse) entries are NOT delivered to Antigravity CLI (no groundable remote-entry shape — see docs/cli-matrix.md row 7h); stdio entries reach all four CLIs.
